name: Stuffed Heart
source:
Stuffed Heart is a visual novel where you can interact with your new plushie! You brought it home thinking it was just a cute little doll, but nope, inside there was also Stein, a cow-man—I mean, bull—with whom you'll have to interact throughout the game if he decides to stay with you.

[Translated from [url=https://kkkqueisko.itch.io/stuffed-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
